name: train-xlmr-smoke
description:
Smoke run of the token classifier's training path on MetaCentrum: a hundred
examples from each train split, 40 steps of 8 on XLM-RoBERTa large in bf16, scored
on the first 25 documents of each development split. Proves the path and times a
step; its scores say nothing about the model.
